criteria: PASS: direction of score broadly aligns with non-formula observable facts, or discordance is explained by scope/prior/components. QUESTIONABLE: opposite score/benchmark quartiles or important construct ambiguity. CLEAR PATHOLOGY requires two genuinely independent facts on the same intended construct and unexplained opposite tails; this package cannot certify that with same-feed benchmarks alone.
